name: Chicken
travel: Lumbridge farms or south of Falador.
strategy: Any attack one-shots. Ideal for training level 1 combat.
mechanics: Passive farm bird.
warnings: None.

name: Cow
travel: North of Lumbridge or south of Falador craft guild.
strategy: Melee with sword or scimitar. Collect cowhide for early Crafting and GP.
mechanics: Docile livestock.
warnings: None.

name: Goblin
travel: East Lumbridge, Goblin Village north of Falador.
strategy: Fast attack speed weapons (scimitar, shortbow) clean them out quickly.
mechanics: Small humanoids wielding crude daggers.
warnings: None.

name: Guard
travel: Varrock Palace entrance or Falador Castle gates.
strategy: Safespot behind castle fences with Ranged/Magic, or engage with melee and food.
mechanics: City defense guards. Drops Medium Clue Scrolls (1/128).
warnings: Several guards can gang up in multi-combat zones.

name: Hill Giant
travel: Edgeville Dungeon via brass key shack, or Shayzien.
strategy: Safespot behind stalagmites with Magic Shortbow or Iban staff, or fight with melee prayer.
mechanics: Drops Big bones and Giant keys to fight Obor.
warnings: Hits up to 4; bring basic food if not praying melee.

name: Moss Giant
travel: Varrock Sewers, Crandor, or Catacombs of Kourend.
strategy: Cast Fire spells (Fire Bolt/Blast) for massive 50% weakness multiplier, or safespot with Ranged.
mechanics: Mossy key drops to fight Bryophyta.
warnings: Hits up to 8 with crush melee.

name: Fire Giant
travel: Waterfall Dungeon, Catacombs of Kourend, Stronghold Slayer Cave.
strategy: Cast Water spells (Water Wave/Surge) for massive +50% damage boost, or safespot with ranged.
mechanics: High strength giant; drops Rune scimitar and valuable herbs.
warnings: Hits up to 11 melee damage; maintain distance or pray melee.

name: Lesser Demon
travel: Karamja Volcano, Taverley Dungeon, Catacombs.
strategy: Equip Arclight or Silverlight/Darklight for huge demonbane bonus, or safespot with Magic.
mechanics: Demonic fiend with 0 magic defence.
warnings: Hits up to 8.

name: Greater Demon
travel: Catacombs of Kourend, Brimhaven Dungeon, Chasm of Fire.
strategy: Arclight shreds greater demons. In Catacombs, bury bones to replenish prayer continuously.
mechanics: Demonbane weapons grant +70% accuracy and +30% damage.
warnings: Hits up to 10 melee damage.

name: Black Demon
travel: Catacombs of Kourend, Taverley Dungeon, Brimhaven Dungeon.
strategy: Arclight is supreme. Wear Prayer boosting gear (Proselyte / Neitiznot) and camp Protect from Melee.
mechanics: Demonic juggernaut; high hitpoints pool (157 HP).
warnings: Hits up to 16 with melee. Never fight without prayer or safespot.

name: Bloodveld
travel: Slayer Tower (Morytania) or Catacombs of Kourend.
strategy: CRITICAL MECHANIC: Bloodvelds attack with Melee rolled against your MAGIC DEFENCE! Wear Black/Blessed d'hide or Karils.
mechanics: Melee attack checked against player Magic defence. Superior variant: Insatiable Bloodveld.
warnings: Do NOT wear heavy melee plate armour; your negative magic defence will cause every hit to land!

name: Dust Devil
travel: Catacombs of Kourend (northeast quadrant) or Smoke Dungeon.
strategy: Wear Facemask or Slayer Helm (i)! Group dust devils using darts, then cast Ice Burst/Barrage for 150K+ XP/hr.
mechanics: MANDATORY: Facemask or Slayer helm required! Without it, stats drain rapidly. Superior: Choke devil.
warnings: DO NOT enter without Facemask / Slayer Helmet! Your stats will immediately drain to 0.

name: Gargoyle
travel: Slayer Tower top floor (Canifis fairy ring CKS).
strategy: Use Crush weapon (Sarachnis cudgel, Abyssal bludgeon, or Dragon mace). Bring a Rock Hammer to smash at low HP.
mechanics: Rock Hammer required to deliver finishing blow at sub-9 HP (or unlock 'Gargoyle Smasher'). Superior: Marble Gargoyle.
warnings: Cannot be killed without Rock Hammer unless auto-smash perk is unlocked.

name: Kurask
travel: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (fairy ring AJR) or Iorwerth Dungeon.
strategy: MANDATORY: MUST use Leaf-bladed sword, Leaf-bladed battleaxe, or Broad bolts/arrows! All other weapons deal 0 damage.
mechanics: Immune to non-leaf-bladed and non-broad damage! Superior: King Kurask.
warnings: Normal weapons deal ZERO damage! Bring Leaf-bladed battleaxe/sword or Broad bolts.

name: Nechryael
travel: Catacombs of Kourend or Slayer Tower top floor.
strategy: In Catacombs, group with darts and Ice Burst/Barrage. Summons death spawns which increase magic healing/exp.
mechanics: Summons Chaotic Death Spawns. Arclight excels for single target. Superior: Nechryarch.
warnings: Hits up to 11 melee damage; spawn minions can overwhelm if not praying melee.

name: Abyssal Demon
travel: Slayer Tower top floor or Catacombs of Kourend.
strategy: Arclight shreds them in seconds for single combat. In Catacombs, group them and cast Ice Burst/Barrage.
mechanics: Teleports next to player randomly. Drops Abyssal whip (1/512). Superior: Greater Abyssal Demon.
warnings: Teleport mechanic can disrupt pathing and lure additional demons.

name: Skeletal Wyvern
overheadPrayer: Protect from Melee (if close) or Protect from Missiles
travel: Asgarnia Ice Dungeon (south of Port Sarim / rimmington fairy ring AIQ).
strategy: MANDATORY: Equip Elemental shield, Mind shield, Dragonfire shield, or Ancient wyvern shield! Stand in safespot with Crossbow.
mechanics: Icy breath freezes and deals 50+ damage without proper shield! Undead dragon (Salve ei works with DHL).
warnings: NEVER fight without an icy breath protection shield! Anti-dragon shield DOES NOT protect against wyvern breath!

name: Marble Gargoyle
travel: Spawns randomly when killing Gargoyles on Slayer task.
strategy: Turn on Protect from Melee. Move away when it throws grey stone balls. Smash with Rock hammer at sub-9 HP.
mechanics: Ranged stone attack immobilizes on impact. Superior variant of Gargoyle with 1/200 spawn chance.
warnings: Hits up to 38 with ranged stone ball if you do not step away!

name: Greater Abyssal Demon
travel: Spawns randomly while killing Abyssal Demons on task.
strategy: Equip Arclight or Emberlight. Keep Protect from Melee active continuously.
mechanics: Superior abyssal demon. Teleports aggressively and hits up to 31 melee damage.
warnings: Can rapidly deplete hitpoints if prayer drops.

name: Revenant Dragon
travel: Revenant Caves (Level 35 Wilderness).
strategy: MANDATORY: Equip Salve amulet (ei) (+20% dmg/acc) and Wilderness weapon! Keep high hitpoints against PKers.
mechanics: Wilderness + Undead: Salve (ei) stacks with Wilderness weapon buffs (+50% dmg/acc)!
warnings: Deep wilderness multi-combat! Watch for PKers and keep Royal Seed Pod / teleport ready.

name: Green Dragon
weakness: Stab Melee (Lance / Fang / D Sword) / Dragonbane
travel: Wilderness west of Dark Warriors' Fortress or north of Edgeville.
strategy: MANDATORY: Anti-dragon shield or Dragonfire shield + Antifire potion! Stab weapons kill fastest.
mechanics: Breathes dragonfire. Drops Dragon bones and Green dragonhide.
warnings: In Wilderness: beware of low-level PKers. Bring 3 valuable items only.

name: Brutal Black Dragon
weakness: Dragon hunter crossbow / Dragon hunter lance / Twisted bow
travel: Catacombs of Kourend (requires 77 Slayer).
strategy: Camp Protect from Magic and drink Extended Antifire potion. Attack from range with DHCB or Bowfa.
mechanics: Attacks with high magic and unblockable dragonfire breath. Slayer 77 required to enter lair.
warnings: Dragonfire and magic combined will hit 50+ if Antifire potion runs out!

name: Scurrius
weakness: Ratbone weapons (Bone mace/bow/staff +10 max hit), Crush
overheadPrayer: Protect from Missiles / Magic / Melee (Telegraphed overheads)
travel: Varrock Sewers via manhole near the palace.
strategy: React to projectile colors (Orange = Ranged, Blue = Magic). Dodge falling ceiling shadows.
mechanics: Falling debris shadows. Overhead prayer switching. Spawns giant rat adds.
warnings: Do not stand still when ceiling debris shadows appear.

name: Vorkath
travel: Torfinn at Rellekka docks to Ungael.
strategy: Dragon hunter crossbow + Salve amulet (ei) + Dragonfire ward. Walk the acid fireball phase (Woox walk). Cast Crumble Undead on Zombified Spawn.
mechanics: Acid pool fireball barrage. Freezing zombified spawn. Dragonfire breath.
warnings: MANDATORY Dragonfire protection shield on 1H setup! Vertical orange fireball is a 1-hit kill; move 2 tiles away!

name: Zulrah
weakness: Magic on Green/Orange phases; Ranged on Blue (Tanzanite) phase
overheadPrayer: Protect from Missiles / Magic depending on phase
travel: Zul-Andra teleport scroll or fairy ring BJS.
strategy: Switch between Magic (Trident/Sang/Shadow) and Ranged (Blowpipe/Bowfa) as Zulrah transitions phases. Wear Ring of Suffering (i) for Snakeling recoil.
mechanics: Rotations: Green (Magic attacks), Blue (Ranged attacks), Orange (Melee swipes). Venom clouds.
warnings: Venom immunity required (Serpentine helm or Anti-venom+).

name: Calvar'ion
weakness: Crush Melee ONLY (Ursine chainmace / Cudgel / Dragon mace), Salve (ei)
travel: Wilderness graveyard via Annakarl or Burning Amulet.
strategy: MANDATORY: Equip Crush weapon and Salve amulet (ei)! Dodge lightning markers and shield attacks.
mechanics: Crush vulnerability (+0 crush def vs +150 stab/slash def!). Undead (+20% Salve bonus). Spawns hellhounds at 50% and 25% HP.
warnings: Slash and stab weapons deal near-zero damage! Wilderness lair: watch out for PKers.

name: Corporeal Beast
travel: Games necklace to Corporeal Beast lair.
strategy: MANDATORY: Use a Spear (Zamorakian spear). Non-spear weapons suffer 50% damage reduction penalty. Spec down with DWH/BGS/Arclight.
mechanics: 50% damage reduction against ALL non-spear weapons! Dark energy core drains prayer and heals Corp.
warnings: Never use slash or crush weapons here! 50% penalty cripples non-spear DPS.

name: Kree'arra
travel: God Wars Dungeon (Armadyl Eyrie).
strategy: MANDATORY: RANGED ONLY! Kree'arra is flying and CANNOT be attacked with melee. Chin off flight minions or shoot with Bowfa.
mechanics: Immune to melee attacks! Blows players back if not engaged in combat.
warnings: DO NOT BRING MELEE WEAPONS! Flying mechanic prevents melee contact.

name: TzTok-Jad
overheadPrayer: Protect from Missiles / Protect from Magic (Active Reaction)
travel: TzHaar Fight Cave (Mor Ul Rek).
strategy: Watch animations: Slams hooves = Protect from Missiles; Reared back on hind legs = Protect from Magic. Tag 4 Yt-HurKot healers when they arrive.
mechanics: Telegraphed 1-hit KO attacks (hits up to 97!). 4 healers spawn at 50% HP.
warnings: Missing a single prayer switch will usually 1-shot you for 90+ damage!

name: Al-Kharid Warrior
travel: Al-Kharid Palace.
strategy: Aggressive human warrior. Easy melee or magic target.
mechanics: Attacks on sight when low combat.
warnings: Multi-combat inside palace.

name: Ice Giant
travel: Asgarnia Ice Dungeon or White Wolf Mountain caves.
strategy: Cast Fire spells (Fire Bolt/Blast) for huge 50% elemental bonus.
mechanics: Giant humanoid infused with ice magic.
warnings: Hits up to 7 with crush.

name: Ogre
travel: King Lathas' training camp or Feldip Hills.
strategy: Safespot behind fences with Dwarf multicannon and Ranged.
mechanics: Slow high-HP brute. Prime cannon training target.
warnings: None.

name: Turoth
travel: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.
strategy: MANDATORY: Equip Leaf-bladed sword/battleaxe or Broad bolts. All other weapons deal 0 damage.
mechanics: Immune to non-leaf-bladed and non-broad damage.
warnings: Non-leaf-bladed weapons deal ZERO damage.

name: Basilisk
travel: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.
strategy: MANDATORY: Equip Mirror shield or V-faceguard! Without it, petrifying gaze drains stats.
mechanics: Petrifying gaze drains player stats if not wearing Mirror shield or V-faceguard. Superior: Monstrous Basilisk.
warnings: Do not remove your Mirror Shield!

name: Basilisk Knight
weakness: Crush Melee (Fang / Mace / Cudgel) / Mirror Shield required
travel: Jormungand's Prison (Fremennik Exiles quest).
strategy: MANDATORY: Mirror shield or V-faceguard required! Pray Magic continuously and use Crush.
mechanics: Drops Basilisk jaw (1/1000 on task). Stone encasing special attack: click ground to dodge.
warnings: Mirror shield or Neitiznot faceguard mandatory to prevent instant stat drain.

name: Drake
travel: Mount Karuulm (Karuulm Slayer Dungeon).
strategy: MANDATORY: Boots of stone / brimstone / granite required! Step 2 tiles away from volcanic eruption balls.
mechanics: Volcanic magma ball attack deals 50+ if not dodged. Dragonbane bonuses apply.
warnings: Extreme heat floor! Boots of stone / granite mandatory.

name: Wyrm
travel: Mount Karuulm Slayer Dungeon.
strategy: MANDATORY: Boots of stone required. Stand in melee range and pray Protect from Magic.
mechanics: Attacks with Magic or Melee. Drops Dragon sword and Dragon harpoon.
warnings: Boots of stone / brimstone required for floor heat.

name: Hydra
overheadPrayer: Protect from Missiles / Magic (Switches every 3 attacks)
travel: Mount Karuulm Slayer Dungeon (requires 95 Slayer).
strategy: Counts attacks: switches between Ranged and Magic every 3 shots. Dragonbane weapons and Water spells shred them.
mechanics: Regular hydra encounter in Karuulm. Dragonkin creation. Superior: Colossal Hydra.
warnings: Hits up to 22; count attacks and switch overhead prayers.

name: Kraken
weakness: Magic ONLY (Trident of the seas / swamp / Sanguinesti)
travel: Kraken Cove (southwest of Tree Gnome Stronghold).
strategy: MANDATORY: MAGIC ONLY! Submerged: immune to melee and ranged. Wear Karils or Blessed d'hide for magic defence.
mechanics: Kraken attacks with magic rolled against player magic defence. Trident of swamp is standard.
warnings: DO NOT BRING MELEE OR RANGED! Kraken is 100% immune to melee and ranged.

name: Rune Dragon
travel: Lithkren Vault (Dragon Slayer II).
strategy: MANDATORY: Insulated boots required for lightning phase! Dragon hunter lance with Dragonfire shield.
mechanics: Insulated boots required to survive lightning floor conductor. Dragonfire breath and life-leech bolts.
warnings: DO NOT forget Insulated Boots; conductive floor deals lethal shock damage.

name: Tekton
weakness: Crush Melee ONLY (Dragon warhammer / Inquisitor / Bludgeon / Fang)
travel: Chambers of Xeric (Mount Quidamortem).
strategy: MANDATORY: Land Dragon warhammer specs to reduce massive defence! Step back every attack cycle to avoid molten meteors.
mechanics: Extreme crush weakness relative to slash/stab. Returns to anvil to repair armor and heal.
warnings: Heavy crush hits up to 60+; step back to dodge anvil sparks.

name: Great Olm
weakness: Melee hand: DHL (Dragonbane); Mage hand: Trident/Sang/Shadow; Head: Twisted Bow/Bowfa
travel: Chambers of Xeric Final Boss.
strategy: Dragon hunter lance deals +20% damage to Melee hand. Turn head using 4:1 or 3:1 running methods.
mechanics: Dragonkin guardian. Acid pools, burn status, crystals, and portals.
warnings: Falling crystals and burn specials deal rapid group damage.

name: Kephri
weakness: Kalphite / Scarab: Keris Partisan (33% bonus + 3x proc) / Fang
travel: Tombs of Amascut (Nekhret).
strategy: MANDATORY: Equip Keris Partisan of Breaching or standard Keris (+33% damage to Kalphites)! Dodge dung bombs.
mechanics: Shield phases regenerate armor. Swarms heal shield. Kalphite classification triggers Keris boost.
warnings: Dung walls trap players; exploding scarabs deal unblockable 30+ damage.

name: Sand Crab
travel: Hosidius coastal shore or Crabclaw Isle.
strategy: AFK combat training with high hitpoints and zero defence.
mechanics: Disguises as a rock. Aggressive for 10 minutes.
warnings: Reset aggro every 10 mins by running out of view.

name: General Graardor
travel: God Wars Dungeon (Bandos Stronghold).
strategy: Tank in melee range with high defence armour, or 6:0 / 7:0 kite with Bowfa.
mechanics: Ground slam attack, minion trio (Sergeant Strongstack, Grimspike, Steelwill).
warnings: High melee punch hits up to 60. Pray Melee in boss chamber.

name: Sarachnis
travel: Forthos Dungeon under Hosidius.
strategy: MANDATORY: CRUSH WEAPONS ONLY! Slash and stab weapons suffer heavy damage penalties.
mechanics: Web trap root, sticky web projectile, spawns spiderlings at 66% and 33% HP.
warnings: Kill spawn minions immediately or swap overheads to match their styles.

name: K'ril Tsutsaroth
travel: God Wars Dungeon (Zamorak Fortress).
strategy: Arclight or Emberlight provide massive +70% accuracy and +30% damage bonuses. Or kite with Shadow.
mechanics: Yielash prayer slam smites 50% prayer and deals 40+ damage if praying melee without step-under.
warnings: High poison damage (16). Bring Antidote++.

name: Commander Zilyana
weakness: Ranged (Twisted Bow / Bowfa / Crossbow) or Shadow
travel: God Wars Dungeon (Saradomin Encampment).
strategy: High movement speed. Must run clockwise along outer perimeter walls while shooting.
mechanics: Melee slap hits 30+; magic attack hits 20+; Bree, Growler, Starlight minions.
warnings: Keep stamina active at all times. Never stop running.

name: Phantom Muspah
weakness: Ranged (Bowfa / Crossbow with Sapphire bolts) & Magic (Shadow / Trident)
travel: Weiss (Icy Grotto under salt mine).
strategy: Step back when melee form raises arms; cross map during shield phase with sapphire bolts.
mechanics: Melee phase, ranged phase, dark spikes, prayer shield phase.
warnings: Stay out of dark ice spikes which deal heavy rapid damage.

name: King Black Dragon
weakness: Dragonbane Weapons (Dragon Hunter Crossbow / Lance) & Stab
travel: Ghorrock / Burning Amethyst into Level 41 Wilderness passage.
strategy: MANDATORY: Full dragonfire protection (Antifire potion + Anti-dragon shield). Stand in melee distance with Protect from Melee.
mechanics: Three dragonfire breath types (poison, freeze, shock stat drain).
warnings: Do not step in without dragonfire protection active.

name: Giant Mole
weakness: Dharok's Greataxe or Ranged (Bowfa / Twisted Bow)
travel: Falador Park underground tunnels.
strategy: Dharok 1 HP method or Bowfa. Falador Shield 3/4 provides mole locator tracking.
mechanics: Digs to random room when damaged below 50% HP. Spades required.
warnings: Bring light source (Bullseye lantern) or darkness inflicts damage.

name: Dagannoth Kings
travel: Waterbirth Island dungeon.
strategy: Rex: Magic (Trident / Iban). Prime: Ranged (Bowfa / Blowpipe). Supreme: Melee (Whip / Fang).
mechanics: Three kings in circular room. Safe-spot Rex south edge.
warnings: Aggroing all three simultaneously can cause instant death.

name: Spindel
travel: Wilderness level 29 cave.
strategy: Heavy crush weakness. Step away during web throw; kill spiderling spawns.
mechanics: Web trap, spiderlings, stat drain.
warnings: Wilderness boss! Level 30 teleport (Royal seed pod) required.

name: Artio
weakness: Magic (Accursed sceptre / Trident) or Ranged (Webweaver / Bowfa)
travel: Wilderness level 21 cave.
strategy: Freeze with Ice Barrage / Entangle and kite from distance.
mechanics: Bear roar, bear traps, enrage phase at 25% HP.
warnings: Wilderness boss! Never let Artio reach melee range while unfrozen.

name: Barrows Brothers
weakness: Wind Spells (+50%), Magic (Iban's / Trident), Ranged for Ahrim
overheadPrayer: Protect from Melee (Dharok, Verac, Torag, Guthan), Missiles (Karil), Magic (Ahrim)
travel: Barrows teleport tablet directly to mounds, or Fairy ring BKR / Mort'ton minigame teleport.
strategy: Kill Dharok first while prayer is high! Then Karil and Ahrim. The remaining melee brothers have 0 magic defence and melt to Wind Surge, Iban Blast, or Trident. Loot chest after killing all 6.
mechanics: Dharok hits up to 55+ at low HP. Crypt drains prayer every 15-18s. Kill 6 brothers + 2 skeletons + 1 bloodworm for 86.2% max rune reward potential.
warnings: NEVER fight Dharok without Protect from Melee active! He can one-shot players with 55+ damage.

name: Cerberus
overheadPrayer: Protect from Magic / Prayer flicking summoned souls
travel: Key master teleport to Cerberus lair, or Taverley Dungeon pipe (70 Agility).
strategy: Arclight or Emberlight with high prayer bonus. Bring Spectral spirit shield for ghost phase (reduces prayer drain from 30 to 15 per ghost).
mechanics: Summoned Souls (Ghosts): Magic (blue), Ranged (green), Melee (red) attack in sequence. Grrr (Lava pools): move immediately.
warnings: Ghosts drain 30 prayer each (15 with Spectral). Failing to pray drains 90 prayer and deals 30 damage per ghost!

name: Alchemical Hydra
weakness: Dragonbane weapons (DHCB / DHL / Bowfa / Twisted bow)
overheadPrayer: Protect from Magic / Missiles (alternates every 3 attacks)
travel: Rada's blessing 4 or Fairy ring CIR / Karuulm Slayer Dungeon elevator.
strategy: Lure Hydra onto colored chemicals to lower its 75% defense reduction per phase: Green onto Red, Blue onto Green, Red onto Blue. Count 3 attacks per style then switch prayer.
mechanics: Poison vents (Phase 1), Lightning (Phase 2), Fire wall (Phase 3), Enrage phase (Phase 4): alternates attacks every single hit!
warnings: Standing on incorrect vents or failing to lure results in 75% damage penalty. Enrage phase acid pools.

name: Grotesque Guardians
weakness: Crush (Bludgeon / Mace) for Dusk; Ranged (Blowpipe / Bowfa) for Dawn; Rock hammer required
overheadPrayer: Protect from Missiles / Protect from Melee
travel: Slayer ring to Slayer Tower roof, or Canifis teleport.
strategy: Dawn is fought with Ranged; Dusk is fought with Melee crush. Use Rock hammer or Granite hammer to smash them at 0 HP.
mechanics: Falling rocks (shadows on ground). Energy orbs (absorb to prevent healing). Flame prison (escape opening).
warnings: Always bring a Rock hammer or auto-smash unlocked, or they heal back!

name: Duke Sucellus
weakness: Demonbane (Emberlight / Arclight) & Slash (Soulreaper axe / Fang / Saeldor)
travel: Ring of shadows to The Stranglewood / Lassar undercity.
strategy: Brew 2 Arder-musca poisons to wake Duke. Hide behind pillars during Gaze attack. Step 1 tile back between melee hits to avoid slam.
mechanics: Eye Gaze (hide behind pillar), Vent debris, Extremity attacks, Enrage sub-25% attack speed.
warnings: Failing to hide behind pillar during Gaze attack inflicts 80+ piercing damage and madness.

name: Vardorvis
weakness: Slash (Soulreaper Axe / Blade of Saeldor / Tentacle whip / Fang / Bellator)
overheadPrayer: Protect from Melee (Protect from Missiles when Strangle head shoots)
travel: Ring of shadows to The Stranglewood.
strategy: Dodge flying axes that spawn from perimeter. Step off red spikes immediately. Prayer flick green head missiles. Quick-hit blood strangled tentacles.
mechanics: Flying axes, Ground spikes, Strangle head missile, Tentacles, Enrage attack speed below 200 HP.
warnings: Axes and spikes cause severe bleeding. In enrage, attacks speed up to 2 ticks; focus on dodging!

name: The Whisperer
weakness: Shadow of Tumeken / Sang staff / Trident of the swamp
overheadPrayer: Protect from Magic / Protect from Missiles (3-attack rhythm)
travel: Ring of shadows to The Stranglewood / Cam Dooral undercity.
strategy: Shadow of Tumeken or powered staff. Count attacks: 3 ranged, 3 magic. Move across shadow realm pads when insanity rises.
mechanics: Sanity drain, Leech spirits, Pillar phase, Shadow realm switch, Tentacle waves.
warnings: Reaching 0 sanity results in continuous 10 damage ticks until death.

name: The Leviathan
weakness: Bow of Faerdhinen / Zaryte Crossbow / Blowpipe / Shadow
overheadPrayer: Protect from Missiles / Magic / Melee (prayer flicking incoming projectiles)
travel: Ring of shadows to The Scar.
strategy: Stun Leviathan with Shadow barrage or Smoke spell when attack speed becomes too fast to pray against. Shoot exposed weak spot on back.
mechanics: Accelerating attack speed, Rocks falling, Lightning discharge, Abyssal orbs, Stun mechanics.
warnings: Failing to stun resets attack speed to extreme 1-tick rate with unavoidable damage!

name: Nex
weakness: Stab (Osmumten's Fang) & Crossbows (ZCB / ACB with Ruby Dragon Bolts (e))
travel: Frozen Key door in God Wars Dungeon / Ancient Prison.
strategy: 5 phases: Smoke (Fumus), Shadow (Umbra), Blood (Cruor), Ice (Glodius), Zaros. Keep distance in Smoke phase to avoid cough infection. Kill reavers in Blood phase.
mechanics: Choke/Cough (contagious virus), Shadow smash, Blood sacrifice & siphon (DO NOT ATTACK during siphon!), Ice prison, Wrath explosion.
warnings: Attacking Nex during Blood Siphon heals her! Step out of shadow splats instantly.

name: Kalphite Queen
weakness: Keris Partisan / Crush for Phase 1; Ranged (Bowfa / Blowpipe) for Phase 2
overheadPrayer: Protect from Magic / Protect from Missiles
travel: Fairy ring BIQ or Desert amulet 4 to Kalphite Lair (bring 2 ropes).
strategy: Phase 1: 100% immune to Magic and Ranged! Use Keris Partisan of Breaching or Bludgeon. Phase 2: 100% immune to Melee! Switch to Ranged (Bowfa or Blowpipe).
mechanics: Prayer immunity per phase (overhead prayers match full protection), 100% accurate magic/ranged attacks that ignore player defense.
warnings: Her magic and ranged attacks never roll accuracy; they always hit unless prayed against!

name: Abyssal Sire
overheadPrayer: Protect from Missiles (Phase 1-2) / Protect from Melee (Phase 3)
travel: Fairy ring DIP or Slayer ring to Abyssal Nexus.
strategy: Cast Shadow barrage to disorient Sire. Kill 4 Respiratory Systems with ranged/trident. Melee Sire with Arclight/Emberlight. Run south when miasma fumes spawn.
mechanics: Respiratory systems, Scions (spawns), Poison fumes, Teleport explosion (Phase 3: move away immediately!).
warnings: Miasma poison fumes deal 30+ rapid damage. Phase 3 explosion will 1-shot players nearby!

name: Corrupted Gauntlet (CG)
overheadPrayer: Protect from Magic / Protect from Missiles (switches every 4 attacks)
travel: Teleport crystal to Prifddinas / Gauntlet portal.
strategy: Gather materials to craft Tier 3 weapons (Bow + Staff) and Tier 1 or 2 armor, 2 potions, full inventory of paddlefish. Count Hunllef's 4 attacks to switch overheads. Avoid tornados and orange floor tiles.
mechanics: Prayer deactivation prayer (purple projectile), 4-attack style switch, Floor hazards (orange tiles), Corrupted tornados that chase player.
warnings: Stepping on illuminated orange tiles inflicts 20+ damage per tick. Tornados kill instantly if they catch you!

name: Tombs of Amascut (ToA)
travel: Fairy ring AKP / Necropolis.
strategy: 4 paths: Scabaras (Kephri), Crondis (Zebak), Het (Akkha), Apmeken (Ba-ba), followed by Wardens P1, P2, and P3/P4. Manage invocations for higher raid level.
mechanics: Simon says memory puzzle, Jug pushing, Simon says mirrors, Ba-ba baboons, Wardens core and lightning.
warnings: Enrage Wardens lightning floor: keep moving and never stand in warden projectile paths!

name: Chambers of Xeric (CoX)
weakness: Melee (DHL on Olm hand, Tekton), Ranged (Olm head, Shamans), Magic (Mage hand)
travel: Xeric's Talisman to Xeric's Honour / Mount Quidamortem.
strategy: Run the Olm head: Mage hand on right side, Melee hand on left side. Avoid falling crystals and lightning walls.
mechanics: Falling crystals, Lightning walls, Teleport pairs, Burn effect, Acid drip, Life siphon.
warnings: Falling crystal shadows inflict 40+ damage; stay on the move!

name: Theatre of Blood (ToB)
weakness: Slash (Scythe of Vitur / Blade of Saeldor / Whip) & Chins / Blowpipe
travel: Drakan's Medallion to Ver Sinhaza.
strategy: 6 rooms: Maiden, Bloat, Nylocas, Sotetseg, Xarpus, Verzik Vitur. Scythe of Vitur is king across nearly all rooms.
mechanics: Maiden blood spawns, Bloat stomp/flies, Nylo waves (style matching), Sotetseg maze, Xarpus poison, Verzik pillar/cabbage/tanking.
warnings: Verzik green bounce ball deals 75+ damage if not bounced between teammates!

name: Callisto
weakness: Wilderness Weapons (Ursine chainmace / Viggora's) & Heavy Crush
travel: Annakarl teleport (Wilderness Level 51) or Obelisk to Level 50.
strategy: Ursine chainmace with ether charges. Pray Magic. Stand on safe perimeter or lure into singles lair (Artio).
mechanics: Shockwave attack (deals high melee damage and throws player backwards). White roar magic attack.
warnings: Deep wilderness level 50+! High risk of PKers; keep player attack options hidden.

name: Venenatis
travel: Carralangar teleport (Wilderness Level 84 / 30) or Canoe to Moss Giant Island.
strategy: Ursine chainmace on crush. Pray Magic. Group Spiderlings and kill them quickly before they drain prayer.
mechanics: Web attack (traps player), Spiderling spawns that drain prayer and deal chip damage.
warnings: Multi-combat Wilderness level 28! Keep 1-click teleport handy.

name: Vet'ion

travel: Ghorrock teleport (Level 44 Wilderness) or Canoe.
strategy: Ursine chainmace on crush with Salve amulet (e). Dodge purple lightning sparks. Kill skeletal hellhounds at half health.
mechanics: 2 lives! Reborn phase triggers upon first death. Purple lightning strikes (move 2 tiles).
warnings: Multi-combat Wilderness level 35! Salve amulet (e) is easily replaced if PKed.

name: Chaos Elemental
weakness: Bow of Faerdhinen / Craw's Bow / Webweaver / Trident
travel: Obelisk to Level 50 Wilderness / Rogues' Castle.

mechanics: Un-equip attack (forces equipment off if free inventory slots exist). Teleport attack.
warnings: Deep wilderness level 50! Keep inventory full of food at all times.

strategy: Fang or Scythe on slash. Redemption flicking or walk-under method between attacks.

warnings: MANDATORY Slayer helmet or Face mask; without it, instant stat drain and asphyxiation!

name: Skotizo
travel: Catacombs of Kourend center altar (requires Dark Totem).
strategy: Equip Arclight or Emberlight. When purple awakened altars activate, hit them once with Arclight to immediately destroy them and drop Skotizo's defense.

warnings: Destroy altars promptly; 4 active altars make Skotizo nearly invulnerable.
